name: Humpback Whale
intro: A humpback whale is a huge animal that lives in the ocean. It is famous for its songs.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A humpback whale is a mammal.
It is about as big as a school bus.
It is dark on top.
It has very long flippers.
Each whale has its own tail pattern, like a fingerprint.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Humpback whales live in oceans all over the world.
In summer, they eat in cold water near the poles.
In winter, they swim to warm water to have babies.
This long trip is called a migration.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Humpback whales eat krill and small fish.
Krill are tiny animals that look like shrimp.
A humpback whale has no teeth.
It uses baleen to strain food out of the water.
Some whales blow a ring of bubbles to trap fish.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A baby whale is called a calf.
The calf is born in warm water.
The calf drinks its mother's milk.
A mother and calf often touch with their flippers.
The calf stays close to its mother for about a year.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: Male humpbacks sing long songs.
A song can last up to 30 minutes.
Their songs can travel for miles underwater.
Humpbacks can leap all the way out of the water.
This big jump is called breaching.

vocab.meaning: An animal that breathes air and feeds its babies milk.
Tiny sea animals that look like shrimp.
